name: India
registration_steps: Visit the National Voters' Service Portal (voters.eci.gov.in)
Fill in your personal details: name, date of birth, address
Upload documents: Aadhaar card, passport photo, address proof
Submit the form online or visit your local BLO (Booth Level Officer)
Track your application status on the NVSP portal
Receive your EPIC (Voter ID Card) by post within 4-6 weeks
voting_steps: Download your Voter Slip from voterportal.eci.gov.in or Voter Helpline App
Locate your polling booth using the Voter Helpline App (1950)
Carry your EPIC (Voter ID) or any of 12 approved alternative IDs
Arrive at your polling booth during voting hours (7am - 6pm)
Join the queue and present your Voter Slip to the presiding officer
Get your finger marked with indelible ink
Collect your ballot and go to the EVM (Electronic Voting Machine)
Press the button next to your chosen candidate
Your vote is recorded with a beep and VVPAT slip shown for 7 seconds
voting_hours: 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM (may vary by constituency)
notes: India uses Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs). Voters can check name on electoral roll via SMS: 'ECI <Voter ID Number>' to 1950.
